sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.6
sources.evidence: Dated August 12, 2026; announces same-day availability in Cursor, Grok Build and the API. Describes supplemental training, regenerated supervised trajectories and agentic reinforcement learning.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 original reopened. Training section describes longer supplemental training, Grok 4.5-generated SFT trajectories and agentic RL; it supplies no active count or structural change contradicting the released 1.5T nominal scale.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 API model specification
sources.evidence: Exact grok-4.6 documentation and embedded model object specify 500000 context tokens, text/image input, text output, function calling, structured outputs and reasoning efforts low/medium/high/xhigh with high default.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 exact API model page reopened. Current model details retain the exact grok-4.6 identifier and published service capabilities, but supply neither a learned total nor active count.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Model Card, August 12; revised August 17, 2026
sources.evidence: The 42-page card identifies Grok 4.6 as a release in its 1.5T-scale family (printed p 5). Footnote identifies SpaceXAI as a DBA of XAI LLC and interchangeable with xAI. Pages 5–6 describe Cursor collaboration, hosted distribution, text/image input, text output and training. No active count or network topology is supplied. Official PDF opened through web; direct terminal download returned 403.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 original 42-page PDF reopened and complete same-day text searched. Printed page 5 identifies Grok 4.6 as a release in the 1.5T-scale family; section 1.2 on page 6 describes pretraining, supplemental training, SFT and RL. This supports nominal 1500B, not an exact tensor census. No activated-count disclosure or expert layout appears; fused MoE in the inference benchmark describes the optimization task, not a model configuration.

sources.title: Elon Musk original X post, July 28, 2026
sources.evidence: Official syndication payload identifies Musk and timestamp 2026-07-28T15:20:02Z. The complete relevant sentences name Grok 4.6 as the 1.5T model with improved SFT/RL and target release around August 7. This is prospective size corroboration; the released-model card supplies confirmation, and the target date is superseded by the actual announcement. Original post: https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2082123925283041545.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 original X syndication payload fetched October 27 at 18:30:31 UTC to /tmp/parameter-533-reaudit/founder.json. Author elonmusk and July 28 timestamp verified. The complete first size statement explicitly names the upcoming 4.6 as 1.5T with improved SFT/RL. It is prospective corroboration; the released card independently confirms that nominal scale. The later post text is truncated, but the relevant 4.6 statement is complete. No active count is supplied.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 Model Card, September 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Reviewed later 30-page card and exact Grok 4.6 comparison entries. It discusses 4.6 training lineage and evaluation results but supplies no 4.6 active count or architectural configuration. No 4.7 figures are transferred.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 original 30-page successor PDF reopened and full same-day text searched. Section 1.2 describes 4.6-generated SFT data; capability comparisons, including section 6.2 CVE-Bench, give scores for exact 4.6 rather than parameter columns. No nominal active size is supplied. Teacher-generated trajectories do not establish equal model size.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 help and model lineage
sources.evidence: Co-developer explicitly states Grok 4.6 has the same base as Grok 4.5, pretrained from scratch, and describes the four configurable reasoning efforts. This provides the exact-model base mapping used with the original 4.5 architectural disclosure.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 original co-developer help page reopened; its What is Grok 4.6 section explicitly identifies the same base as Grok 4.5, pretrained from scratch. This supports named-base continuity, but gives neither an active size nor routing/expert configuration.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.5, July 8, 2026
sources.evidence: Original co-developer announcement explicitly identifies Grok 4.5 as a mixture-of-experts model jointly trained with SpaceXAI. Used only through Cursor's explicit 4.6 same-base relationship; it does not independently report 4.6 expert configuration or active size.
sources.parameter_reaudit_evidence: Fresh October 27 original Cursor research announcement reopened. A strong foundation explicitly calls Grok 4.5 mixture-of-experts; no numerical active count or expert layout appears. Combined with the exact 4.6 same-base statement, it corroborates retained MoE lineage but yields no active number.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 model reference in Cursor
sources.evidence: Exact 4.6 page lists a 256k context window for Cursor and distinguishes reasoning effort from fast serving. This is a provider-specific limit; the catalog retains the native xAI API 500000-token figure.

sources.title: Enterprise Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Section 4.1 retains ownership of services and underlying models/technology in SpaceXSI or its suppliers; no model intellectual-property rights are transferred. The 4.6 card subjects use to enterprise/consumer terms. Supports proprietary classification, not an open-weight license. Read through web; direct terminal fetch returned 403.

sources.title: Official xai-org model inventory
sources.evidence: Inventory returned only xai-org/grok-1 and xai-org/grok-2 at review, with no Grok 4.6 checkpoint. Corroborates the card's hosted distribution and proprietary terms; inventory absence alone is not treated as proof.

sources.title: Files API
sources.evidence: Documents that file attachments invoke the server-side attachment_search tool automatically. Lists Grok 4.6 support and PDF among file formats; this does not make PDF a native model input modality.

sources.title: API release notes, August 12, 2026
sources.evidence: August 12 entry announces Grok 4.6 on the xAI API with 500k context, text/image inputs and text-only output, independently confirming the launch day and native contract.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.7: later original comparison and base distinction
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 original opened. Model Improvements explicitly says 4.7 uses a new, larger base than 4.6. Exact 4.6 comparisons report prices and capability metrics, without total/active parameter columns. Neither the successor size nor its training-data relationship supplies 4.6 active parameters.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 GPT-6 Astra Pro estimate: rejected active-count lead
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full original page opened to trace the 200B active claim. Provenance identifies a September 25 GPT research run, and its public-facts item 5 explicitly calls 200B active and 120B/300B alternatives assumptions. It is an inference-cost scenario, not a model-team parameter disclosure or original measured active-count comparison. Do not adopt it.

name.note: Official display name; exact native API identifier is grok-4.6.

developer.note: Retain normalized xAI developer. The card explicitly equates xAI and SpaceXAI (XAI LLC DBA) and credits development collaboration with Cursor.

family.note: Official Grok release lineage; the card explicitly identifies this as a continuation of Grok 4.5.

release_date.note: Actual public Cursor/Grok Build/API launch, not the July 28 planned August 7 date. No earlier actual public release was established; later cloud-provider rollouts do not replace this date.

open_weights.note: Released through hosted products and APIs under proprietary terms; no 4.6 checkpoint distribution found in the official model inventory.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model. Service terms retain rights in underlying models; this is not an SPDX open-source license.

parameters_b.note: Retain the developer-published nominal 1.5T scale as 1500B. Fresh review of the released-model card identifies exact Grok 4.6 within that scale; the original founder post independently names upcoming 4.6 as the 1.5T model with improved SFT/RL. Cursor explicitly confirms the same base as 4.5. The training disclosures describe supplemental training and SFT/RL, with no conflicting pruning, expert expansion or replacement-base disclosure. This is a nominal model specification, not an exact tensor census or active-per-token figure.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh separate active-count searches and original source review found no supported numerical active size. The released card, founder post and same-base disclosure preserve 1500B total but provide no expert configuration or active count. Later original 4.7 comparisons give task scores, not activated-parameter columns. The secondary 200B claim is explicitly a GPT-generated assumption with 120B/300B scenarios and is rejected; do not equate total with active or transfer an unrelated successor/teacher size.

architecture.note: Linked inference from explicit first-party lineage: Cursor says 4.6 uses the same base as 4.5, and its original 4.5 research announcement identifies that base as mixture-of-experts. This supports MoE only; Transformer subtype, routing, expert numbers and active dimensions remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Native xAI API maximum, confirmed in the exact model object. Cursor separately documents 256k. Limits are provider-specific; the 200k native long-context pricing threshold is not the context maximum.

modalities.note: Native input/output modalities match the exact API record. PDF/file handling uses attachment_search; product image generation and other tools do not establish native image output.

reasoning.note: Native feature flag is true; low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning efforts are supported, with high as default.

tool_call.note: The exact grok-4.6 embedded API model specification enables functionCalling; model documentation also describes the capability.

description.value: Reasoning model developed by xAI with Cursor for coding and other knowledge work, with text and image inputs and text output.
description.note: Replace unsupported promotional frontier framing with developer collaboration, intended use and documented modalities.

patch.description: Reasoning model developed by xAI with Cursor for coding and other knowledge work, with text and image inputs and text output.

sources.label: Musk exact-model size disclosure (original X payload)

patch.notes: 1500B is the nominal 1.5T scale stated in the released model card and corroborated by the founder's pre-release statement; active parameters remain undisclosed. MoE follows Cursor's explicit same-base relationship to Grok 4.5 and its architectural disclosure; expert configuration is undisclosed. Native API context is 500000 tokens; Cursor documents 256k. Released August 12, superseding the earlier August 7 target. Native text/image inputs and text output exclude file-search and generation tools.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retained the supported nominal 1500B total and left active_parameters_b null/undisclosed. Reopened the released card, original founder disclosure, exact API page and Cursor same-base/MoE lineage. Later 4.7 card and release comparisons supplied no active count; rejected the secondary 200B GPT assumption. Added explicit patch counts and fresh provenance. All twelve other field assessments are unchanged.

parameter_reaudit.comparison_search: Searched total and active/activated counts separately, including exact-model arXiv and developer-domain queries. No original model-team comparison with a supported 4.6 active-count convention was found. The later original 4.7 card was searched in full for parameter/active/expert terms and its exact 4.6 comparison rows inspected; all pertinent rows concern capability scores. The successor release likewise supplies prices and scores only. Cursor's 4.7 announcement points to that same original release and adds no counts.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_review: Cursor explicitly identifies Grok 4.6 as sharing the Grok 4.5 base. The released 4.6 card directly supports 1.5T scale, so total need not be inferred solely from a teacher. Supplemental training, SFT and RL provide no conflicting structural change. The original 4.5 MoE disclosure does not provide active size. Grok 4.5-generated SFT trajectories alone would not establish weight identity, and 4.7 explicitly introduces a larger new base.

rejected_leads.reason: The page explicitly labels these as GPT-generated scenario assumptions rather than a disclosed or measured model specification.

parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Exact tensor/component accounting, expert routing/configuration and nominal active parameters remain undisclosed; this does not invalidate the supported 1500B nominal total.
